observations: Month, Day and Week each preserve readable selected Item notes and saved Schedule caption in wide and narrow native inspector presentations.
Hidden details give width back to the calendar; native date/zone/Today/details controls stay inside the visible pane.
After widening, hidden details remain hidden; reopening restores the selected Item and Schedule.
Dark native surfaces, semantic text, blue selections and links remain readable in the retained states.

Week keeps its horizontally scrollable date range; some selected-event cards are outside the viewport while the retained details remain visible. This is not proof of every calendar scroll/keyboard/accessibility state.
limits: iPad inspector only. These images do not show or qualify the Mac HSplitView, Mac Month scroll viewport, physical devices, contrast modes or final whole-app polish.
